'''Hai Caemlyn''' was a city in [[Coremanda]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]].

During their constructions after the [[Breaking of the World]], [[Ogier]] built a [[Ways|waygate]] to Hai Caemlyn.{{ref/book|6|20}} The city of [[Caemlyn]], capital of [[Andor]], was built on the ruins of Hai Caemlyn and derived it's name from the destroyed city.
